# Let's read all habit tracker logs and extract the limited_screen_time_to_1_hr status
note_ids = [1534, 1533, 1532, 1531, 1530, 1529, 1528, 1527, 1526, 1525, 1524, 1523, 1522, 1521]
habit_status = {}
for nid in note_ids:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=access_token)
    # Extract the line for limited_screen_time_to_1_hr
    for line in note['content'].split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('limited_screen_time_to_1_hr:'):
            status = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            # Use the date from the title
            date_str = note['title'].replace('Habit Tracker Log for ', '')
            habit_status[date_str] = status
            break
print(habit_status)

# Sort dates chronologically

max_streak = 0

        current_streak += 1
        max_streak = max(max_streak, current_streak)
    else:
